purpose: Teach: 谷口/柳沢/奥田/新井/荒木/浅野/村山/大田

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、谷口刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: Detective Taniguchi's response at the scene is getting good marks from above.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acknowledgment. Light, steady tone. Professional confidence without self-importance. Quick pace — this is shop talk between colleagues who understand the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人柳沢氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: You're being careful interviewing the witness Yanagisawa, I see.
lines.style: Observational, collaborative. Warm undertone — noting competence without making it awkward. Slight gentle curve upward at the end, like a quiet compliment wrapped as a statement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者奥田氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: And you're taking care to reach out to the victim Okuda's family too.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before starting. Steady, sincere delivery. Acknowledging the human dimension of the work. Not rushed — this matters. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の新井巡査の指導もされますね
lines.en: Officer Arai's getting good coaching from you in the station.
lines.style: Easy, collegial. Brief warmth on the observation — acknowledging mentorship without fuss. Conversational pace. The tone of someone who notices when others teach well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査官荒木氏の聞き込み調査を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: You're moving forward with the canvassing work through Investigator Araki's door-to-door.
lines.style: Steady, confirming. Professional forward momentum in the tone. Even pace, clear commitment. Not pushing — just recognizing the work is underway.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、鑑識の浅野主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: Scene examination with Asano, the forensics supervisor — that's scheduled?
lines.style: Brief, efficient check-in. Professional but warm. Slight lift at the end — genuinely asking, not just verifying. The tone of a colleague keeping things coordinated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪心理士の村山様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: You're getting consultation from Murayama, the criminal psychologist?
lines.style: Approving recognition. Thoughtful pace — this shows good judgment in reaching for expertise. Warm respect underneath. Slight lift at the end, like: good call.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の大田様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And you've been in the pre-trial conference with Prosecutor Ota already.
lines.style: Knowing observation. Warm, direct. Acknowledges the weight of moving through the formal process. Steady confidence — this is how serious work gets done. Slight settling at the end.
